meta.title: Download Reports: Download Event Detailed Report with specific individual checkboxes selected
gaps: Verify that the downloaded report contains only Event Ref ID and Event Title columns and no other columns.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the downloaded report contains only Event Ref ID and Event Title columns and no other columns.

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event on the buyer's Master QCS screen.
Navigate to the RFQ stage named by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the report control is available.
Select the Event Ref ID column.
Download the report with the selected columns.
Confirm that an Excel report was downloaded containing both requested column headers.
